label: Scientific Writing
description: Research-to-publication pipeline for academic and scientific papers
connectors: Research findings inform the literature review

stages.label: Research Notes
stages.subtitle: Data & Observations
stages.description: Collect raw data, observations, and preliminary findings
stages.ai: Identifies patterns in raw data, suggests hypotheses, flags missing controls
stages.output: Organized research notes with tagged observations

stages.label: Literature Review
stages.subtitle: Prior Work
stages.description: Survey existing literature and establish theoretical framework
stages.ai: Identifies citation gaps, suggests related papers, checks for conflicting findings
stages.output: Comprehensive literature review with citation map

stages.label: Draft Sections
stages.subtitle: First Draft
stages.ai: Checks logical flow, suggests clearer phrasing, flags unsupported claims
stages.output: Complete first draft of all manuscript sections

stages.label: Peer Review
stages.subtitle: External Feedback
stages.description: Submit for internal or external peer review
stages.ai: Simulates reviewer concerns, identifies weak arguments, suggests clarifications

stages.label: Revisions
stages.subtitle: Refinement
stages.description: Address reviewer feedback and refine the manuscript
stages.ai: Tracks changes against reviewer comments, ensures all feedback addressed

stages.label: Final Paper
stages.subtitle: Publication Ready
stages.ai: Checks journal formatting, validates references, generates submission checklist
